R-0109 does not lock the parser predicate that suppresses `.cursor/` copies when `--host opencode` while still installing kernel rows from the same section — only additive opencode sections are specified. Without an explicit mixed-section skip contract (prefix filter vs host-tagged rows), PowerShell/Bash/Python installers can diverge on whether `.cursor/` is copied, skipped, or partially upgraded before `/architecture` authors the US-0121 interface.
